# ADR-3209: AWS encryption: KMS CMK required key for data class 1

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

AWS-managed defaults avoids meet separation needs.

## Decision

Sensitive data stores SHALL declare a KMS CMK required key for data class 1 (AWS-encryption-1).

## Consequences

CMK policies separate admins from users.
